VBO:0200358.summary: Playful affection and vocal watchfulness can go together in Chonzers, the Miniature Schnauzer–Bichon Frise cross. Lexi loved squeaky toys, walks and couch cuddles, balancing outings with relaxed time near her people. She announced visitors, strange noises and birds, yet could be unsure around unfamiliar people. Her own life shows close attachment alongside a busy, expressive character.
